sentences.en: I was angry about missing that film at the cinema.
sentences.zh: 我因为错过在电影院看那部电影而感到生气。

sentences.en: My dear little cat has been missing for a week.
sentences.zh: 我的小猫已经失踪一个星期了。

sentences.en: Let me apologize once again for missing our meeting.
sentences.zh: 请允许我再次为未能参加我们的会议道歉。

senses.zh: 错过，未做到；未到场，缺席
